name: rsa
reason: No upstream patch exists. Only the SQLx MySQL tests enable mysql-rsa. SQLx uses public-key encryption for client authentication, never the private-key operation affected by the Marvin timing attack. The published libraries leave mysql-rsa to the app. Review or remove by expiry.

name: ctutils
reason: The fix (0.4.4) needs Rust 1.87, and the lockfile builds the core and cronwatch-tokio-cron-scheduler on their Rust 1.85 floor. The lockfile is not published: an app on Rust 1.87 or newer resolves the fixed release. The core reaches ctutils through digest for HMAC-SHA256 signing of outgoing webhooks, which computes a MAC and never compares one. Remove when the floor reaches 1.87.

name: crypto-bigint
reason: The fix (0.7.6) requires ctutils 0.4.5, which needs Rust 1.87, and Cargo keeps one ctutils 0.4 release for the whole lockfile, held at 0.4.2 for the Rust 1.85 floor. crypto-bigint is reached only through SQLx's mysql-rsa, which only the MySQL tests enable, and it encrypts with a public key there. The lockfile is not published. Remove when the floor reaches 1.87.

name: golang.org/x/crypto
reason: This advisory covers only the unmaintained OpenPGP packages and has no patched module release. The unpublished examples do not import OpenPGP, directly or transitively. The scanner verifies that absence before accepting this exception.

name: cowlib
reason: Test-only Phoenix server dependency. No patched Cowlib release exists. The upstream advisory identifies Cowboy 2.16.0 or newer as protected by its default invalid_response_headers=error_terminate behavior; this fixture leaves that default intact. The scanner requires that protected Cowboy version in the same inventory. Published packages do not depend on Cowboy or Cowlib.
